brief:
The Government Media Office in Gaza issued an urgent national appeal Monday to rescue the housing and living conditions of more than two million displaced persons, Shehab Wire reported. Officials warned of catastrophic consequences if current shelter arrangements continue without intervention.

The statement placed responsibility on the international community while directly addressing what the office described as an Israeli veto on the entry of caravans into the territory. The appeal underscored deteriorating conditions among the displaced population and called for immediate action to break what officials termed a blockade on essential shelter materials needed to provide adequate housing.
